title: Drill 2: Accident Management - Training IDs 1.5-1.7 (Fractures, Crush Injuries, Chest Trauma)
description: To refresh the DMT’s and MFA’s fading skill in Accident Management
objectives: To refresh the DMT's and MFA's fading skill in Accident Management
The participants will be able to discuss indication for use of Accident management procedures.
Training ID 1.5: Fracture management and splinting techniques.
Training ID 1.6: Crush injury assessment and treatment.
Training ID 1.7: Chest trauma recognition and emergency management.
Discuss the equipment, positioning, step-by-step description of procedure
Discuss and demonstrate Accident Management techniques.
activities: Presentation of the above topics by the Medic through lectures hand-outs. Showing sample photos and instructional videos.
Demonstration on how to apply the above topics.
Guided Practice and Independent Practice by the participants and Group Activities.
